The lambdas are load-bearing: Span implementations define these methods on the class prototype (the file's own comment at :80-84 documents this), so a bare method reference like `end: span.end` detaches `this` and breaks at call time. `span.end.bind(span)` is no tersest-form improvement over the explicit delegate and loses parameter-name clarity.

exception.boundary: Applies to any object-proxy wrapper over a class-instance API; the S4 direct-ref rule targets free-function passthroughs, not method delegation.
